verdict.rationale: ClickHouse is genuinely open-source and self-hostable: docs and a live probe confirm a single-binary install via curl script with no account/key required, and clickhouse-local/full server runs locally performing real SQL workloads. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosted deployments at scale (single desktops to hundreds of nodes), confirming this isn't just marketing. missing for 10: independent third-party audit of self-hosting ease at enterprise scale, and more detail on operational/maintenance burden (some community reports note ops overhead)
